feature: Title tiles play, and a few knobs restyle a title
summary: Library title tiles now play while you point at them and loop while picked, over your own recording where the style uses it. A placed title gets a Title section (Theme, Font Pair, Energy, Intensity, Background) that restyles the whole thing at once, and a Part section for each part's In, Hold and Out with Replay.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open a recording, add a track above it and right click the empty track: Add Title Page > Midnight. Type a headline and press Command Return, then click the title once.

evaluate: Are Theme, Font Pair, Energy, Intensity and Background the right five knobs, in that order, before the parts?
Do the theme swatches read well enough at this size, or would you rather a dropdown with names?
Is the difference between Calm, Normal and Punchy big enough to feel?
Does a tile that plays on hover and loops while picked help you choose, or is the motion distracting?
Is the Part section's length (In, Hold, Out with their knobs) acceptable, or should its knobs fold away until asked?
rough: No mock covers the Title or Part sections; they use the panel's own controls (UX-PATTERNS §4): swatches, dropdowns for lists of more than three, segments for three, a slider for a strength.

Replay is a one-shot verb in the panel, which the placement contract leaves to the open card the-panel-shows-what-the-picked-thing-is-and-its-how-many-buttons-may-the-right-h; it is also on the title's right-click and in Clip as Replay Title.
Typing replays the in when the words are put down (Command Return or clicking away), not live while typing; no walk times the replay after typing yet.
From Recording samples two or three colours from the clip under the title; no walk presses it yet, and on the sample recording it gives a dark blue ground.
Glass is offered in Background only when a picture is on screen under the title; an opening title page that pushes the recording along has nothing under it, so it cannot be glass.
Original is the first entry in Theme and Font Pair, so a preset's own look is always one click back.

Dark words keep a soft light halo from the shadow the typed title wears, which reads but is the drop shadow look the research calls template-y; step 6 (a-set-of-titles-that-look-designed) owns the presets' look.
Titles placed before this change carry no recipe, so they show no Title section.
Behind the Next switch next-title-restyle, on by default.
